mapper.select: SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id, flow_key AS flowKey, task_type AS taskType, trigger_source AS triggerSource, biz_id AS bizId, created_by AS createdBy, status, max_attempts AS maxAttempts, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.number')) AS number, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload, '$.text')) AS text, scheduled_at AS scheduledAt FROM fcc_dial_job WHERE job_type = 'AUTO_FLOW' AND trigger_source = #{triggerSource} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50 OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT owner_work_no FROM fcc_customer WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fcc_dial_job WHERE id = #{id} AND job_type = 'AUTO_FLOW'
